newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brierley to "creep" up Fairfax stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brierley to "creep" up Fairfax stake.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd executive director Rodney Price said on Friday the company would raise its stake in John Fairfax Holdings Ltd to 25 percent using the "creep" provisions in Australia's Corporations Law.
Earlier, John Fairfax shareholderd voted, on a count of proxies, against a proposal by Brierley to increase its stake in the newspaper publisher by five percent to 25 percent.
If the vote was confirmed, Price said Brierley would use the "creep" provisions to lift its stake to 25 percent in about six months.

Under the creep provisions a company is allowed to lift its stake above the 20 percent level in the target company by three percent every six months without having to make a takeover offer. "A no vote for us is simple. It means we don't outlay the money for six months," Price told reporters.

"Absolutely," he said when asked if Brierley would use the creep provisions to increase its stake to 25 percent in the next six months. Price agreed that Brierley would increase its stake to 25 percent given the current creep provisions.
